title: 第7章 调虎离山第8章 坊市
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
烧火房干净整洁，徐惊云四处张望，东摸摸西看看。
而徐子奇则是对林江月赞不绝口：“原来张兄住处可不像如今这般，都是林师妹的功劳。”
林江月抿嘴一笑给他们倒茶后便开始洗米洗菜。
等到一更，徐惊云有些坐不住，在后院溜雏英鸡。
这时，一道光落入瓦舍。
“让徐师兄久等。”
林江月见张大虎已到，上前问好，并请大家边吃边聊。
张大虎结了两个法阵，徐子奇又加了一层。
“什么事要做这么复杂的阵法？”徐子奇端起碗筷先吃一口：“林师妹惊为天人啊，这厨艺可比张兄！”
张大虎瞪眼歪头，徐子奇立刻领会：“实话实说嘛。”
“哈哈哈——”
“哈哈哈——”
众人皆笑，只有张大虎表情严肃。
“今日火炽真人请我去，说了两件事，一是查到沐府失火真相；二是将我收为外门弟子。”
徐子奇听罢，起身拱手祝贺。
“这是好事啊。”
张大虎放下碗筷，示意林江月、徐惊云离座。
“这意味着，我要调走……”
月色渐冷，林江月与徐惊云走出瓦舍，徐惊云面对她，背着手倒走。
“也不知会聊多久，我带你去后山吧，你肯定没去过。”

“后山有什么？”
“人面鼠你见过吗？火属性妖兽，可挣不少灵石。”
林江月摇头说道。
“徐师兄，有一件事向你讨教。”
“不敢不敢，师妹请讲。”
“你知不知道入门弟子考核都有些什么？”
“这个简单，与其说是考核，不如说是看谁的法器法宝厉害，有家底的比试自然……”
徐惊云顿了顿，看向林江月，以前没仔细看，现在竟觉得有些好看。
“也可不看这些，若是入门时为三灵根可直接被真人长老挑选进入外门，若是三灵根练气七层以上可与双灵根竞争内门弟子。单灵根属于一枝独秀，会被各个元婴长老争抢。”
林江月找到一块空地坐下，托着下巴凝视前方。
“怎么了？”徐惊云也坐了下来。
林江月又从身前拿出一本书研读起来。
徐惊云则拿出小舟在溪边玩水。
“用不着这么努力，有些事儿已成定局。”
林江月想着自己没有入门考核，有些遗憾。
但遇到张大虎这样的师父，似乎这些遗憾也不算遗憾了。
待到东山浮光跃。
徐惊云赶去炼丹房。
林江月原路返回，跻身穿过门前悬停的纸鹤。
“林江月，你来一下。”
content_en:
The fire room was clean and tidy. Xu Jingyun looked around and touched here and there.
Xu Ziqi, on the other hand, was full of praise for Lin Jiangyue: "It turns out that Brother Zhang's residence is not like it is now. It is all the credit of Junior Sister Lin."
Lin Jiangyue pursed her lips and poured tea for them before starting to wash rice and vegetables.
By the time of the first watch, Xu Jingyun couldn't sit still and walked around with chickens in the backyard.
At this time, a ray of light fell into the house.
"Keep Senior Brother Xu waiting."
Seeing that Zhang Dahu had arrived, Lin Jiangyue stepped forward to say hello and invited everyone to chat while eating.
Zhang Dahu formed two magic circles, and Xu Ziqi added another layer.
"Why do you need such a complicated formation?" Xu Ziqi picked up the bowl and chopsticks and took a bite first: "Junior Sister Lin is amazing, her cooking skills are comparable to Brother Zhang!"
Zhang Dahu glared and tilted his head. Xu Ziqi immediately understood: "Tell the truth."
"Hahaha——"
"Hahaha——"
Everyone laughed, but Zhang Dahu had a serious expression.
"Master Huo Chi invited me today and said two things. One is to find out the truth about the fire in Mu Mansion; the other is to accept me as an outer disciple."
After hearing this, Xu Ziqi stood up and held his hands in congratulations.
"This is a good thing."
Zhang Dahu put down his bowls and chopsticks and signaled Lin Jiangyue and Xu Jingyun to leave their seats.
"This means that I have to be transferred..."
The moonlight was getting colder, Lin Jiangyue and Xu Jingyun walked out of the house, Xu Jingyun faced her and walked away with his hands behind his back.
"I don't know how long we'll chat for. I'll take you to the back mountain. You must have never been there."
"What's in the back mountain?"
"Have you ever seen a human-faced rat? A fire-attribute monster can earn a lot of spiritual stones."
Lin Jiangyue shook her head and said.
"Senior Brother Xu, I have something to ask you."
"Don't dare, don't dare, junior sister, please tell me."
"Do you know what the entrance examinations are for disciples?"
"This is simple. It's not so much an assessment as it is to see whose magic weapon is more powerful. It's natural for those with family background to compete..."
Xu Jingyun paused and looked at Lin Jiangyue. He didn't look at it carefully before, but now he thought it looked pretty good.
"You don't have to look at these. If you have three spiritual roots when you enter, you can be directly selected by the real elders to enter the outer sect. If you have three spiritual roots and are above the seventh level of Qi training, you can compete with double spiritual roots for inner disciples. Single spiritual roots are unique and will be competed by various Nascent Soul elders."
Lin Jiangyue found an open space and sat down, holding her chin and staring ahead.
"What's wrong?" Xu Jingyun also sat down.
Lin Jiangyue took out another book from in front of her and started to study it.
Xu Jingyun took out his boat and played in the water by the stream.
"There's no need to work so hard, some things are a foregone conclusion."
Lin Jiangyue felt a little regretful thinking that she did not take the entrance examination.
But when meeting a master like Zhang Dahu, it seems that these regrets are no longer regrets.
Wait until Dongshan floats with light.
Xu Jingyun rushed to the alchemy room.
Lin Jiangyue returned the same way and crossed the paper crane hovering in front of the door.
"Lin Jiangyue, come here."
